what: a flint felling axe: a heavy broad head of crude knapped grey-brown flint with chipped faceted edges and lighter flake scars, a plain wooden handle, the head lashed on with tan sinew cord. Same layout as the attached felling axe: the handle runs from the bottom-left corner up to near the top-right; the head sits crosswise at its top; the blade sticks out to the UPPER LEFT, flaring strongly to a wide, gently curved cutting edge PARALLEL to the handle; a solid flat poll sticks out to the lower right. Never a vertical edge. 1-2 px margin from the canvas sides
